mentions.name: news.freight.nyc
mentions.description: A Hacker News-style news aggregator focused specifically on the freight industry, hosted at news.freight.nyc, intended to serve as a community hub for the sector.
mentions.problem: There is no existing online community for the freight sector aside from Reddit.
mentions.audience: People working in the freight sector
mentions.source_excerpt:
A news aggregator like HN but specifically for freight: https://news.freight.nyc

The idea is mostly to build a community for the sector I work in, since there isn't any (aside from Reddit...)
